items.source: Uses of QuartzJobBean in org.springframework.scheduling.quartz
Support classes for the open source scheduler Quartz, allowing to set up Quartz Schedulers, JobDetails and Triggers as beans in a Spring context.
items.translation: 支持开源调度器 Quartz 的类，允许在 Spring 上下文中将 Quartz Scheduler、JobDetails 和 Triggers 配置为 Bean。

items.source: Quartz Job implementation that invokes a specified method.
items.translation: 调用指定方法的 Quartz 作业实现。

items.source: Extension of the MethodInvokingJob, implementing the StatefulJob interface.
items.translation: 扩展了 MethodInvokingJob 并实现了 StatefulJob 接口。
